title: ArchitectureSpec
description: Structural specification of the system: components, responsibilities, data flow, and constraints. Version 2.0.0.

glId.description: Glossary term identifier, format GL-NNN. Must match an ID in Glossary.json.

version.description: Semver version of this archspec document instance.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the ArchSpec schema this document conforms to. Must be '2.0.0'.

project.description: Must match the project name in the corresponding GoalSpec.

goalSpecVersion.description: Version of the GoalSpec this architecture was designed against.

dataSpecVersion.description: Version of the DataSpec this architecture references. Optional if DataSpec not yet produced.

apiSpecVersion.description: Version of the ApiSpec this architecture references. Optional if ApiSpec not yet produced.

overview.description: High-level description of the system structure. Must be understandable without implementation knowledge.

summary.description: 2–4 sentences describing the system structure, major subsystems, and how they interact.

subsystems.description: Named major subsystems. Each must correspond to one or more components.

purpose.description: One sentence describing what this subsystem does.

componentRefs.description: Component IDs that belong to this subsystem.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) referenced in the overview.

components.description: All major architectural units. Each component has exclusive ownership of its responsibilities.

purpose.description: One sentence: what this component exists to do.

description.description: Longer description of the component's role and behavior. If omitted, 'purpose' is used as fallback.

responsibilities.description: Exclusive behaviours owned by this component. No two components may share the same responsibility.

dependencies.description: Component IDs this component depends on. Must reference real component IDs in this spec.

reqRefs.description: REQ-IDs from the GoalSpec that this component helps satisfy.

nfrRefs.description: NFR-IDs from the GoalSpec that this component is responsible for meeting.

visibility.description: Whether this component is exposed externally or internal only.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) that this component's concepts map to. Use for cross-spec traceability.

fnRefs.description: FN-IDs from ApiSpec that this component owns. Populated during implementation. Use for Component→FN traceability. Each FN must belong to exactly one component.

entityRefs.description: ENT-NNN-slug IDs from DataSpec entities this component works with

dataModel.description: Reference to the canonical DataSpec. If a DataSpec exists, all entity definitions live there — do not duplicate them here.

dataSpecRef.description: Filename or path of the authoritative dataspec JSON.

notes.description: Any architectural notes about the data model not captured in the DataSpec itself.

apiContract.description: Reference to the canonical ApiSpec. If an ApiSpec exists, all interface definitions live there — do not duplicate them here.

apiSpecRef.description: Filename or path of the authoritative apispec JSON.

authStrategy.description: How consumers authenticate with the system, e.g. 'API key in Authorization header', 'local Unix socket — no auth'.

notes.description: Any architectural notes about the API not captured in the ApiSpec itself.

dataFlow.description: Named flows describing how data moves through the system. Each flow names a source component, optional transforms, and a sink component.

description.description: Optional prose summary of this flow. Should not be empty — use to explain the flow's purpose in one sentence.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) that this flow's concepts map to.

steps.description: Ordered steps in this flow. Each step names the acting component and what happens.

action.description: What the component does at this step.

dataRef.description: Optional: name of the entity or payload moving through this step.

constraints.description: Architectural limitations and hard requirements. Each must be independently verifiable.

name.description: Short descriptive name summarizing this constraint (e.g. 'Dynamic Language Stack').

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) that this constraint's concepts map to.
